calibration: Each numbered finding has severity/confidence/prerequisites, source anchors, remediation and proposed regression checks. Browser, library, safety-mode and deployment dependencies are qualified. Wildcard CORS is expressly not equated with credentialed disclosure. Coverage ledger distinguishes full reads, focused/truncated reads and exclusions.

false_positive_review.note: No zero-false-positive claim. All 48 findings were read, but only selected claims were source-adjudicated and no runtime behavior was tested. Anchor existence was checked by the auditor, not proof of semantics.

claims.claim: F40 chat identity uses decode-only JWT data.id
claims.evidence: Coordinator read routes/chat.ts getUserId, lines 42-46: security.decode(token) followed by decoded.data.id, without signature verification in that helper.

claims.claim: F09 memories serialize a joined UserModel
claims.evidence: Coordinator read routes/memory.ts: getMemories calls MemoryModel.findAll({include:[UserModel]}) and res.json(data). Full exposure also depends on model serialization/route gates as traced by report.

ambiguities: G11 includes a MIME-label acceptance observation in F45 but not the intended validation-bypass mechanism; conservative score excludes it.
G31 exposure versus plaintext-storage distinction yields 34/40 if broad match accepted; both G11 and G31 accepted would yield 35/40. These alternatives are not the headline score.

eval_feedback.overall: Grouped root causes hide subcase omissions; scoring presence of one XSS sink is not a measure of complete XSS coverage. Dependency/seed exclusions can be appropriately cautious while lowering detection score. Historical source provenance remains unknown.

grading_method: Coordinator manual per-row grade; saved before opening with-skill report. Full report and process notes reviewed; no execution transcript available.
